evidenceLegend.modelEstimate: Estimated model probability — calibration not verified
evidenceLegend.independentQuote: Observed independent provider quote — not authenticated in original app
evidenceLegend.retrospective: Retrospectively reconstructed — not a prospective hit rate
evidenceLegend.frozenPregame: Originally saved pregame research direction — prior to NHL event
evidenceLegend.officialStats: Official NHL game statistics — NOT original fantasy settlement
evidenceLegend.tier: Provider-indicated tier only; authentic original tier and multiplier UNVERIFIED
evidenceLegend.payouts: Exact selected-line multiplier and expected value UNVERIFIED

responsibleResearch.purpose: Educational statistical research only. No wagers placed.
responsibleResearch.risk: Sports betting involves financial risk. No outcome is guaranteed.
responsibleResearch.limits: Set personal financial and time limits before using any external platform.
responsibleResearch.controls: If research becomes stressful or compulsive, stop using the site and seek local support.

dataProvider: Independent third-party research data; original platform availability unverified

operations.note: Scheduled success and an on-time provider board are different. Missing evidence is not a successful pull.

movements.note: A source row not observed later is not a verified original-app withdrawal; tier changes require one-to-one stable original source identity.

wilson95.method: Wilson 95%, unclustered; same-game dependence not modeled

standardSameLineBenchmark.note: Same exact archived Standard model-selected thresholds; hypothetical Higher/Lower sides not authenticated as executable original-app offers. Old cohort is descriptive and not a predeclared strategic experiment.

futureSimpleStrategyAudit.note: Only future original Git-precommitted Standard model-selected opportunities. Challenger sides were frozen with the original model before games. Includes abstentions, withholds rates for small samples, and does not compare full-board strategy budgets or verified platform returns.

scorecard.note: Descriptive official NHL stat outcomes of original pregame model decisions, never fantasy-app settlement or profitability.

markets.warning: Past-only last5/last10 MAE is disclosed only after 30+ official holdout player-games. It is not an actual PrizePicks-line backtest, prospective calibration, release approval or verified sportsbook offer. TOI regulation-only quotes cannot be graded against full-game overtime TOI.

lineupRisk.note: Cross-lineup player overlap is concentration, not a measured joint outcome probability. Stale lineups are research history, never currently available entries.

movementSummary.note: Counts compare two independent source snapshots, not original PrizePicks moves or removals. No verified closing-line value.

prospectiveCohort.sourceEvidence: Original Git-first-added NHL model selections and official completed game stats
